info.scriptSrcText: property this, startMember, thisMember, frameCounter, Xvel, Xpos, Yvel, rotVel, COPTER, Ypos, spinDir, waitCounterglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gDamagePercenton beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  COPTER = sprite(4)  thisMember = random(12) - 1  startMember = this.memberNum  frameCounter = 1  Xvel = random(3)  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV) - 1000  Yvel = 0  rotVel = 0  spinDir = random(2)  if spinDir = 2 then    spinDir = -1  end if  waitCounter = 45 - the currentSpriteNumendon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    frameCounter = frameCounter + spinDir    if frameCounter = 2 then      frameCounter = 0      thisMember = thisMember + 1      if thisMember > 11 then        thisMember = 0      end if    end if    if frameCounter = -2 then      frameCounter = 0      thisMember = thisMember - 1      if thisMember < 0 then        thisMember = 11      end if    end if    this.memberNum = startMember + thisMember    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset - Xvel    Ypos = Ypos + Yvel    Yvel = Yvel * 0.97999999999999998    this.locH = Xpos    this.locV = Ypos    this.rotation = this.rotation + rotVel    if this.rotation > 360 then      this.rotation = this.rotation - 360    end if    if this.rotation < 0 then      this.rotation = this.rotation + 360    end if    if rotVel = 0 then      xDiff = COPTER.locH - this.locH      if abs(xDiff) < (this.width * 0.5) then        yDiff = COPTER.locV - this.locV        if abs(yDiff) < (this.height * 0.5) then          if yDiff > 0 then            Yvel = -5            rotVel = -8            Xvel = Xvel * 0.5            COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel + 2          else            Yvel = 5            rotVel = 8            Xvel = Xvel * 0.5            COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel - 2          end if          puppetSound(3, member(27, "Sfx"))          gDamagePercent = gDamagePercent + (this.width * 0.25)        end if      end if    end if    if Xpos < -100 then      waitCounter = waitCounter - 1      if waitCounter <= 0 then        Xvel = random(6)        Ypos = 30 + random(270)        Yvel = random(2) - 3        rotVel = 0        this.rotation = 0      end if      Xpos = Xpos + 800    end if    if Xpos > 612 then      waitCounter = waitCounter - 1      if waitCounter <= 0 then        Xvel = random(6)        Ypos = 30 + random(270)        Yvel = random(2) - 3        rotVel = 0        this.rotation = 0      end if      Xpos = Xpos - 800    end if  end ifend
